title: Experienced Weebly Designer Needed for Complete Website Redesign

feed.title: Experienced Weebly Designer Needed for Complete Website Redesign
feed.description:
Project Overview

I am seeking an experienced Weebly website designer/developer to redesign and rebuild an existing website for an established health-related professional services business.

This is not a new website. The business already has an established website, branding, written content, and overall site architecture. The goal is to modernize the website, improve the overall user experience, and create a polished, professional online presence that builds credibility and encourages prospective clients to take the next step.

The website will remain on the Weebly platform, so prior Weebly experience is required.

About the Project
Considerable planning has already gone into this project, including the website architecture, page outlines, written content, branding direction, and overall vision.
I am looking for someone who can bring that vision to life while contributing thoughtful recommendations regarding design, usability, functionality, and user experience.
The initial website is expected to include approximately 12–15 pages, with the potential for future expansion.

Scope of Work
The selected freelancer will serve as both a design consultant and website developer. Responsibilities include:
Evaluating and recommending the most appropriate premium Weebly template/theme as the foundation for the website.
Determining whether the desired functionality can be achieved through the selected template or whether limited custom development is advisable.
Complete redesign and rebuild of the existing website.
Modern, professional UI/UX design.
Mobile-first, responsive design across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Development and implementation within the Weebly platform.
Navigation redesign and user experience optimization.
Image selection and placement.
Icon selection and implementation.
Typography recommendations.
Color palette refinement.
Page layouts and visual hierarchy.
Basic on-page SEO implementation.
Accessibility best practices.
Cross-browser testing and quality assurance prior to launch.
Technical Requirements

Although this project will remain on the Weebly platform, I recognize that the platform has certain limitations.

My preference is to begin with a high-quality premium Weebly template and enhance it through custom development only where necessary to achieve the desired appearance, functionality, and user experience.

The ideal freelancer should be comfortable working with:
HTML
CSS
JavaScript
Weebly custom code

While extensive custom development is not anticipated, the selected freelancer should have the technical expertise to implement custom solutions when they meaningfully improve functionality or overcome platform limitations.

The objective is to maximize the capabilities of the Weebly platform while minimizing unnecessary third-party dependencies and ongoing subscription costs whenever practical.

Contact Form Requirements
The website will include a professional contact form that serves as the primary inquiry method for prospective clients.
The contact form should:
Be fully responsive across all devices.
Provide a clean and intuitive user experience.
Include conditional logic to display or hide questions based on user responses.
Deliver inquiries reliably and securely.
Be easy to maintain and update over time.

Preferred approach: 
Whenever practical, I prefer solutions that utilize native Weebly functionality supplemented with custom code rather than relying on third-party subscription services. However, I recognize that certain functionality may require an external integration. If that is the case, I expect the selected freelancer to:

Explain the available options.
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of each approach.
Identify any ongoing subscription costs.
Recommend the solution that best balances functionality, long-term maintenance, user experience, and overall project goals.

Website Structure
The overall website architecture has already been planned.
The initial website will include approximately 12–15 pages, All written content will be provided.

What Will Be Provided
The selected freelancer will receive:
Complete website copy
Detailed page outlines
Existing website for reference
Branding direction

Design Expectations
The website should feel:
Modern
Professional
Trustworthy
Welcoming
Clean and organized
Easy to navigate

Rather than simply placing content onto pages, I value thoughtful recommendations regarding:
Overall visual design
Layout
White space
Typography
Calls-to-action
Image placement
Icons
Visual hierarchy
User flow

The goal is not simply to build pages—it is to create an intuitive, professional, and conversion-focused website that effectively represents the business.

Functional Requirements
The completed website should include:
Fully responsive design
Mobile optimization
Clean navigation
Responsive contact form with conditional logic
Fast page loading
Internal linking
Basic SEO implementation
Easy editing after launch

Accessibility
The website should incorporate accessibility best practices where supported by the Weebly platform, including:
Proper heading hierarchy
Alternative text for images
Appropriate color contrast
Clearly labeled forms
Readable typography
Mobile responsiveness

Basic SEO
The website should include:
Meta titles
Meta descriptions
Proper heading structure
Image alt text
Clean URLs
Internal linking
Advanced SEO services are not required for this project.

Ideal Candidate
The ideal freelancer:
Has significant experience designing and developing websites in Weebly.
Has strong UI/UX design skills.
Understands responsive web design.
Is comfortable working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when appropriate.
Has experience designing websites for professional service businesses.
Communicates clearly and proactively.
Pays close attention to detail.
Is comfortable making recommendations that improve both functionality and user experience.

Bonus: Experience designing websites for healthcare, mental health, counseling, medical, wellness, or other client-centered professional service organizations.

Deliverables
The completed project should include:
Fully redesigned Weebly website
Responsive implementation across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
Updated navigation
Responsive contact form with conditional logic
Image and icon implementation
Basic SEO optimization
Accessibility improvements
Cross-browser testing
Final review prior to launch

Opportunity for Ongoing Work
Although this posting is for an initial website redesign project, I value building long-term professional relationships with talented freelancers.
If the collaboration is successful, I anticipate future opportunities for website enhancements, additional pages, feature updates, ongoing maintenance, and other design-related projects as the business continues to grow.
My preference is to work with someone who can become a trusted long-term design partner rather than treating this as a one-time engagement.

Proposal Requirements
Please include:
Examples of Weebly websites you have personally designed and developed.
A link to your portfolio.
A brief description of your experience with the Weebly platform.
Your estimated timeline.
Your fixed-price proposal based on the scope outlined above.
Your availability over the next several weeks.
If you believe Weebly presents any limitations that could affect this project, briefly explain how you would address those limitations while maintaining a professional user experience.

Please begin your proposal with the phrase:
"Weebly Redesign"
This helps confirm that you have read the entire project description.

Budget: This will be a fixed rate job. We imagine a possible budget range between $500-$1000. When you reply, please provide your fixed-price quote and we will consider all offers.
